system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 4 lbs. Power Points 20; Recharge 2 per day.

Thin strips of parchment have somehow grown into the polished wood of this staff. The writing upon them changes whenever the bearer encounters an unfamiliar doctrine.

While wielding the staff, you gain a +1-item bonus to Analyse Scripture, Compare Testaments and Recognise Doctrine.

Activate Cast a Spell; Effect You expend the required PP to cast a spell from its list.

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed spells at the indicated PP cost

Spells: Hallowed Rest (2 PP), Oathseal (2 PP), Veil Sight (4 PP), Litany of Remembrance (6 PP).

On the sheet: a staff: its four spells are cast from the item's PP; +1 item is pre-ticked on Analyse Scripture, Compare Testaments and Recognise Doctrine while it is held.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Staff of Sacred Concordance
